第 1 章 总则 Chapter 1 General
手册目的
Purpose
本手册规定 PowerHub SkyLo V1 超轻型飞行器的日常检查、飞行前检查、飞行后检查、定期维护、故障处置、部件更换以及长期存放维护要求。

This manual specifies the requirements for daily inspection, pre-flight inspection, post-flight inspection, scheduled maintenance, troubleshooting, component replacement, and long-term storage of the PowerHub SkyLo V1 ultralight aircraft.
本手册适用于飞行员、地面保障人员及经授权的维修人员。
This manual is applicable to pilots, ground support personnel, and authorized maintenance personnel.
维护基本原则
Basic Maintenance Principles
SkyLo V1 采用模块化分布式电推进系统，主要维护对象包括：
The SkyLo V1 adopts a modular distributed electric propulsion system. The principal maintenance items include:

电机 / Motor ECS / ECS units
高压动力电池 / High-voltage battery packs
高压配电系统 / High-voltage power distribution system飞控系统 / Flight control system
信号及动力线束 / Signal and power wiring
整机救援降落伞系统 / Whole-aircraft emergency parachute system座椅及乘员保护系统 / Seat and occupant protection system

所有维护工作必须按照本手册、相关部件维护文件及经批准的技术变更文件执行。 All maintenance activities shall be performed in accordance with this manual, applicable component maintenance documentation, and approved technical change documentation.

第 7 章 高压动力电池维护 Chapter 7 High-Voltage

SkyLo V1 采用双路高压动力电池系统，两组电池分别为上下旋翼动力系统供电。
The SkyLo V1 uses a dual high-voltage propulsion battery system. The two battery packs independently supply power to the upper and lower rotor propulsion systems.
动力电源路径 / Propulsion Power Path：电池 A → ECS → 上层旋翼
Battery A → ECS → Upper Rotors电池 B → ECS → 下层旋翼
Battery B → ECS → Lower Rotors
两组动力电池具有独立的供电路径及保护功能。
The two propulsion battery packs have independent power supply paths and protection functions.

The purpose of the 800-cycle performance inspection is to determine whether the propulsion battery continues to meet the required capacity, power output, and safety performance requirements for aircraft operation.

根据性能检查结果，对电池进行以下分类：
Based on the inspection results, the battery shall be classified as:
A 类：继续使用 / Category A — Continue in Service
电池容量、功率输出、内阻、温升及 BMS 状态满足设计要求。
Battery capacity, power output, resistance, temperature rise, and BMS condition meet the applicable design requirements.
B 类：限制使用 / Category B — Restricted Service
电池仍具备使用条件，但性能出现明显衰减，应根据技术人员评估降低使用范围或缩短后续检查间隔。
The battery remains serviceable but shows significant degradation. Its operating limitations or subsequent inspection interval shall be adjusted based on technical assessment.
C 类：停止使用 / Category C — Remove from Service
电池存在安全风险，或者性能已经不能满足航空器运行要求。
The battery presents a safety risk or no longer meets the requirements for aircraft operation.
电池循环定义
Battery Cycle Definition
为保证维护记录的一致性，SkyLo V1 将一个完整充放电循环定义为：
For maintenance-record consistency, one complete battery cycle for the SkyLo V1 is defined as:
累计放电量达到电池额定容量 100%的使用过程，计为 1 个完整循环。
A cumulative discharge equivalent to 100% of the rated battery capacity shall be counted as one complete cycle.
例如：
For example:
一次从 100% SOC 使用至 50% SOC，再充电至 100%，计为约 0.5 个循环。
Using the battery from 100% SOC to 50% SOC and then recharging to 100% corresponds to approximately 0.5 cycle.
两次上述使用过程累计计为约 1 个完整循环。
Two such operating cycles correspond to approximately one complete cycle.

GBS 10 救援降落伞系统
GBS 10 Rescue Parachute System
SkyLo V1 采用 GBS 10 整机救援降落伞系统作为应急安全装置。
The SkyLo V1 is equipped with the GBS 10 whole-aircraft rescue parachute system as an emergency safety device.
GBS 10 系统的设计和测试寿命约为 7 次激活。
The GBS 10 system is designed and tested for approximately 7 activations.
该激活次数为系统设计及测试依据，不应在未经制造商确认的情况下将其简单理解为所有系统在第 7 次激活后均自动失效或必须报废。

This activation number represents the system design and test basis and shall not be interpreted, without confirmation from the manufacturer, as an automatic mandatory retirement of every system after the seventh activation.
救援降落伞系统必须严格按照制造商提供的使用和维护手册进行安装、检查、维护和操作。
The rescue parachute system shall be installed, inspected, maintained, and operated strictly in accordance with the manufacturer's operating and maintenance manual.
